scope_note: the largest, most heavily-scoped-down checkpoint in this program. Bridges wasm4pm's ProcessTreeOperator DIRECTLY to mfact's Models/ProcessTree.lean only -- explicitly sidesteps the mfw/mfact POWL disagreement (mfw's POWLBridge.lean is proven but fully abstract, no real operators, unconnected to any concrete formalization; mfact's own Models/Powl.lean has real n-ary operators but NO proven trace-language function, so it cannot be bridged against either). Covers ONLY Sequence, ExclusiveChoice, Parallel, restricted to BINARY trees (matching ProcessTree.lean's binary constructors exactly, no n-ary desugaring built this pass). Excludes Loop (genuinely infinite trace language for nontrivial bodies -- the program requires bisimulation/automata equivalence for cyclic structures, not bounded sampling, deferred to 015B) and Or (confirmed dead code -- zero real production call sites in wasm4pm's discovery/conversion pipelines, no Lean counterpart in either mfact or mfw).

rust_input_type.type: RestrictedTree { Leaf(u8), Seq(Box,Box), Xor(Box,Box), Par(Box,Box) } -- a purpose-built restricted carrier, not wasm4pm::process_tree::ProcessTree directly (that type is n-ary/Loop/Or-capable; no encoder from it to this restricted carrier was built this pass)

lean_input_type.type: ProcessTree (inductive: leaf, silent, seq, xor, par, loop -- only leaf/seq/xor/par used here), ProcessTree.language

decoder.note: hand-transcribed copy of ProcessTree.language's literal definition (leaf/seq/xor/par cases) and its interleavings/seqLang helper definitions, quoted exactly, not executed

canonical_result.name: Language
canonical_result.type: BTreeSet<Vec<u8>> -- finite set of traces (finite because no Loop is present)

rust_output_type.field: rust_language (independently-written second implementation, structurally different code path from lean_language_exact, so the differential is meaningful)

comparison_mode_note: NOT a live Lean invocation -- same constraint as every prior harness (mfact .lake build directory does not exist).
method_note: per the program's own requirement for acyclic structures: all RestrictedTree shapes up to 3 leaves (158 trees at this checkpoint's bounds) are enumerated, and the FULL trace language (a finite set) is compared for exact equality per tree -- not a bounded trace sample, which the program explicitly forbids for cyclic structures (irrelevant here since Loop is excluded) but which this checkpoint exceeds anyway by doing full language equality, not sampling.
not_claimed: direct_theorem/EXACT_CORRESPONDENCE (no live Lean re-verification); coverage of wasm4pm's real n-ary ProcessTree type directly (only a purpose-built binary restricted carrier); Loop (cyclic, deferred to 015B); Or (dead code, no Lean counterpart, no bridge attempted); any POWL-proper claim (partial orders, choice graphs, transitive reduction, normalization, Petri-net conversion -- all deferred, none attempted this pass); mfw's POWLBridge.lean correspondence (sidestepped entirely, not applicable to this bridge)
